# Bid the deck, not the square footage.

> Price a residential deck from height, material, railing lineal feet, and stairs — not a flat dollar-per-square-foot. See walk-away price, price per sf, and whether a $28-a-foot special loses money.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
